limits_note: DEMO MODEL BUILT FROM MOCK DATA: its answers mean nothing. This model was trained and evaluated only on RSCD: road-surface patches from vehicle cameras in China, labelled with six friction levels (dry, wet, water, fresh snow, melted snow, ice). How well it works on roads in other countries, at night, with rain on the lens, or on surfaces outside these classes is unknown. The confidence is calibrated on held-out RSCD data (temperature 1.70) (expected calibration error 0.040 on the test split), so it can be over-confident on other roads. The heatmap shows where the model looked, not proof that it is right. This is a student project, not a safety system.
